businesses.business: Wholesale power generation and coal mining

offering_description.value: Hallador sells wholesale electricity and generating capacity to utilities and other power buyers. It generates power at a coal-fired plant in Indiana and mines thermal coal for its own plant and other utilities.

primary_products.value: wholesale electricity; generating capacity; thermal coal

customer_segment.value: B2B: electric utilities, rural electric cooperatives and other wholesale power buyers

revenue_model.value: product sales: wholesale electricity and thermal coal; project or contract: commitments to make generating capacity available to wholesale buyers

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: runs a coal-fired generating station that supplies electricity and capacity to wholesale buyers; raw materials: mines and prepares thermal coal for its own generating station and other utilities

geography_served.value: US regional: Indiana operations serving Midwestern wholesale power and utility coal markets

specialization.value: related lines: coal-fired electricity generation and thermal coal mining

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bilateral power and capacity agreements and coal supply contracts with utilities; other: wholesale electricity sales through the Midcontinent Independent System Operator market

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FERC oversight of wholesale power sales, environmental and mine operating permits, and federal mine safety rules

notes: The current mix of wholesale customers and the full geographic reach of coal sales are uncertain.
